item.title: GotaTun -- Mullvad's WireGuard Implementation in Rust
item.description:
📝 Since mid-2024 we have been maintaining a fork of wireguard-go to support features like DAITA & Multihop. In the developer console we have seen that more than 85% of all crashes reported have stemmed from the wireguard-go. Since rolling out GotaTun on Android with version 2025.
🔗 Read more: https://mullvad.net/en/blog/announcing-gotatun-the-future-of-wireguard-at-mullvad-vpn
